title: Please
label: ch:ka-please
canDo: I can say please in Kannada, and use the polite verb ending Kannada reaches for far more often than the word itself.

payoff.summary: Build ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು out of daya ("compassion") + iṭṭu ("having placed"), then make the everyday polite request instead: ಕುಳಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, "please sit."
